question: Where in the school can we find lots of wonderful books to read quietly? 📚
explanation: Awesome! The library is a quiet and happy place filled with shelves of amazing books to read and learn from! 📚
hint: It is a room full of books and silence.

question: Where do we go to play fun games and run around with our friends? 🏃
explanation: Great job! The playground is a big open space where we can play sports and have fun together! ⚽
hint: It has swings and a lot of grass.

question: Where do the teachers sit and check our notebooks when they are not teaching? 👩‍🏫
explanation: Super! The staff room is a special place for teachers to work, rest, and check our books! 🛋️
hint: It has the word 'staff' in it.

question: Who is the head of our school and makes sure everything runs smoothly? 🏫
explanation: Fantastic! The principal is the leader of the school community and takes care of all students and teachers! 👩‍💼
hint: They sit in the main office.

question: Where do we go to learn how to type and use the internet safely? 🖱️
explanation: Awesome! The computer lab is full of computers where we learn amazing new digital skills! 💻

question: Where should we go if we feel sick or get a small scratch while playing? 🩹
explanation: Great job! The medical room has a kind nurse who gives us medicine and bandages to make us feel better! 🛏️
hint: It is also called the sick bay.

question: Who helps us cross the road and keeps our school gate safe? 🛑
explanation: Super! The security guard stands at the gate to protect us and keep our school very safe! 👮
hint: They wear a smart uniform and watch the gate.

question: Who takes care of the beautiful flowers and green trees in our school? 🌻
explanation: Awesome! The gardener works hard to plant seeds and water the flowers so our school looks beautiful! 🧑‍🌾

question: Where do we stand together in the morning to sing songs and say our prayers? 🌞
explanation: Fantastic! The assembly ground is where the whole school community meets every morning for prayer! 🎤
hint: We stand in straight lines here.

question: Where do we go to buy a yummy sandwich or drink during recess? 🧃
explanation: Great job! The cafeteria or canteen is where we sit with friends to eat tasty and healthy food! 🥪
hint: It is full of food and tables.

question: What should we do with our empty juice box after drinking it? 🧃
explanation: Super! Throwing trash in the dustbin keeps our beautiful school clean and tidy for everyone! 🗑️
hint: Look for the green or blue bin.

question: How should we board the school bus to stay safe? 🚌
explanation: Awesome! Making a line and waiting for our turn helps everyone board the bus safely and happily! 🚶

question: Who drives the big yellow vehicle to drop us safely to our homes? 🚍
explanation: Fantastic! The bus driver is a community helper who drives carefully to keep us safe on the road! 🚌
hint: They sit behind the steering wheel.

question: Who helps us find the best storybooks in the school? 📖
explanation: Great job! The librarian organizes all the books and helps us choose fun stories to read! 📚

question: What is the best way to act when a new student joins our class? 👋
explanation: Super! Welcoming a new student with a big smile makes them feel happy and safe in our school! 😊

question: Who keeps our classrooms and corridors shining clean every day? 🧹
explanation: Awesome! The sweeper or cleaner works very hard to make sure our school is spotless and hygienic! 🧹
hint: They use a broom and a mop.

question: When we see our teachers in the morning, what should we say? 🌅
explanation: Fantastic! Saying 'Good morning' is a polite way to greet our teachers and start the day happily! 🌞

question: What should we do if we see a tap leaking in the washroom? 💧
explanation: Great job! Closing the tap saves precious water and shows that we care about our school and earth! 🚰

question: Who rings the bell to let us know that recess has started? 🔔
explanation: Super! The peon or office helper rings the bell and helps carry important papers around the school! 🔔

question: Where do we go to mix colors, paint, and make beautiful crafts? 🎨
explanation: Awesome! The art room is a creative place filled with colors, brushes, and paper to show our talent! 🎨

question: If your friend forgets their lunch box, what should you do? 🥪
explanation: Fantastic! Sharing is caring! Giving your friend some food makes the school a very happy place! 🥪
hint: Give them a little piece of yours.

question: Who teaches us how to run fast and play sports correctly? 🏀
explanation: Great job! The sports coach helps us stay fit, learn game rules, and play well as a team! ⚽
hint: They wear a whistle around their neck.

question: Where do we see magical experiments with tubes and magnets? 🧲
explanation: Super! The science lab is an exciting place where we test fun ideas and learn how things work! 🔬
hint: It has microscopes and safety goggles.

question: When we want to speak in class, what is the best thing to do? ✋
explanation: Awesome! Raising your hand shows respect and helps the teacher hear everyone's wonderful ideas! ✋

question: What is the best way to keep our classroom beautiful? ✨
explanation: Fantastic! A clean classroom helps us focus better and makes our school look like a shiny palace! ✨

question: Where do we go to play the drum, piano, and sing in a choir? 🎹
explanation: Great job! The music room is full of amazing instruments where we learn to sing and play melodies! 🎵
hint: You hear a lot of singing here.

question: What should we say when the school helpers clean our classroom? 🧹
explanation: Super! Saying 'Thank you' shows respect and makes our wonderful school helpers feel very happy! 💖
hint: It is a magic word of gratitude.

question: If you find a lost pencil box on the playground, what should you do? ✏️
explanation: Awesome! Giving lost items to a teacher helps find the owner and shows that you are very honest! 👩‍🏫
hint: Hand it over to an adult.

question: How do we work together to finish a big chart paper project? ✂️
explanation: Fantastic! Working as a team means sharing ideas and colors to make the best project ever! 🤝

question: What special day do we celebrate by running races and winning medals? 🏅
explanation: Great job! Sports Day is a thrilling event where the whole school cheers, runs, and plays sports! 🏃

question: If a friend falls down during a race, what is the right thing to do? 🤕
explanation: Super! Helping a friend is more important than winning because true friends care for each other! 🤗

question: Where can we see colorful fishes or a class pet in some schools? 🐠
explanation: Awesome! The nature corner helps us learn how to care for animals and love the environment! 🌿

question: When everyone is reading silently, what kind of voice should we use? 🤫
explanation: Fantastic! Using a whisper voice ensures we do not disturb our friends who are trying to read! 🤫

question: What do we do during the Annual Day function? 🎭
explanation: Great job! Annual Day is a grand celebration where we perform dances, plays, and sing on stage! 🎭
hint: We wear colorful costumes on a stage.

question: Who helps the teacher collect notebooks and keep the class quiet? 🧑‍🎓
explanation: Super! The class monitor is a responsible student who helps the teacher lead the classroom! 🌟

question: Why do we plant small saplings on Environment Day at school? 🌱
explanation: Awesome! Planting saplings helps them grow into big trees that give us fresh air and shade! 🌳

question: What should you do if someone brings a lovely snack from their festival? 🎉
explanation: Fantastic! Sharing festival snacks helps us learn about different cultures and spreads pure joy! 😋

question: How do we show respect to the beautiful books in the library? 📖
explanation: Great job! Handling books gently means many other children can enjoy reading them for a long time! 🤲

question: When the school bell rings at the end of the day, what should we do? 🎒
explanation: Super! Packing your bag neatly helps you not lose anything and leave the classroom looking tidy! 🎒

question: If two friends are fighting over a ball, what is the best thing to do? ⚽
explanation: Awesome! Taking turns is a fair and fun way to make sure everyone gets to play and be happy! 🤝

question: Where do we go with our class to have a fun day outside the school? 🌳
explanation: Fantastic! A school picnic is a wonderful day out where we eat, play, and bond with our classmates! 🧺
hint: We take a bus to a park.

question: What is the big green or black board in the classroom used for? 🖍️
explanation: Great job! The teacher writes important lessons and fun drawings on the board for us to learn! 📝
hint: We look at it to read.

question: What should we do after using the school washroom? 🧼
explanation: Super! Flushing the toilet and washing our hands keeps us healthy and the school very clean! 🚽

question: Who helps us when we cannot understand a tough math problem? 🧮
explanation: Awesome! Our kind teachers are always ready to explain things again until we understand perfectly! 👩‍🏫

question: How can we make our school corridors look bright and colorful? 🎨
explanation: Fantastic! Putting up our lovely drawings on the notice boards makes the school look like an art gallery! 🖼️

question: If your team loses a tug-of-war game, what should you tell the other team? 🤝
explanation: Great job! Saying congratulations shows good sportsmanship and makes everyone feel respected! 👏

question: Why is it important to wear a neat and clean school uniform? 👔
explanation: Super! A clean uniform shows that we are proud of our school and ready to learn looking our best! ✨

question: When we work on a group project, what is the best way to share tasks? 📋
explanation: Awesome! Dividing the work means everyone gets to help and the project is finished quickly and nicely! 🤝

question: Who makes the delicious food we eat in the school cafeteria? 🍲
explanation: Fantastic! The school cook prepares hot, tasty, and healthy meals to give us energy for the whole day! 🧑‍🍳

question: Whose job is it to make our school a happy and safe place? 🏫
explanation: Great job! A school becomes a truly happy place when students, teachers, and helpers all work together! 🤝
